subject: Startups
title: The Role of Middle Management
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Role of Middle Management.

hook.text: Startups hate managers. 'We're flat!' they say—until the company hits 100 people and nobody knows who decides what.

buildup.text: Middle managers translate strategy into execution.

discovery.text: Google tried removing managers in 2002 with 'Project Oxygen.' It failed. They discovered managers mattered a lot.

twist.text: Bad managers are the problem, not management itself.

climax.text: The best companies invest in manager training as seriously as engineering training.

punchline.text: Flat sounds cool. Structure is what actually works.

quiz.question: What happened when Google tried removing managers?
